description: Find UK clinics that can prescribe cannabis-based medicines, by name, town or postcode. Use it for 'which clinics…' questions and to compare published consultation fees. Returns up to 25 clinics, each with its Findabis page URL, town and postcode, first and follow-up consultation fees, consultation types, CQC rating, review score, whether it shows 'Accepting patients', and which patient types its published policy takes. `query` is matched as text, not by distance. It does not return doctors, appointment availability, or whether any person is eligible — only a specialist decides that. For one clinic in full, use get_listing.

acceptingPatients.description: Only clinics showing 'Accepting patients' (an active published eligibility policy).

patientType.description: NEW_PATIENT (never prescribed), TRANSFER (moving from another clinic) or ACTIVE_PATIENT (already under treatment). Leaves out clinics whose published policy does not take that type, and price sorts cost that route.

query.description: Clinic name, town or postcode, matched as text (not by distance). Omit to list all.

sort.description: az (default), za, or by published first-year cost: priceLowHigh / priceHighLow.

name: find_clinics

acceptingPatients.description: Shows 'Accepting patients' (an active published eligibility policy)

patientTypes.description: Patient types the published policy takes; null when the clinic publishes no policy

rating.description: Published patient reviews; null when there are none

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results

title: Find medical cannabis clinics
